op.summary: Write a concise, accurate English summary in your own words. Keep the numerical results and units. Return only the summary.
op.strong: Rewrite as a different textbook author. Reorder information and use fresh wording rather than copying sentences. Preserve every factual statement, number, unit, and condition. Return only the rewrite.
op.light: Lightly rephrase the teaching explanation without changing its meaning. Keep all numbers, units and conditions. Return only the rewritten explanation.
op.fusion: Combine both explanations into one concise teaching passage. Keep each topic's core claims, numerical results, and units. Do not quote the input. Return only the combined passage.
